### Key checks

**Pending prompt recheck (D05–D13):** `awaitPermission` captures settings at initiation and re-reads them at resolution. Ghost mode, quiet hours, `nativeChannelHold`, `inactiveWarning`, ownership (`stillEligible`), clock reversal (`now < started`), and stale prompt (`now - started >= RATE_LIMIT_MS`) are all checked before `presentNotification` runs. All 10 mutation reversals covering these paths pass 1→0→1.

**In-app-only never returns `held-cooldown` (D02, D03, D04):** The `hold || inactiveWarning || stillEligible?.(false) === false` block fires before the rate-limit path. `nativeChannelHold` returns `'in-app-only'` for `channel === 'in_app'` and `'channel-unavailable'` for unknown channels (D03). `'in-app-only'` is in the USER_AUTHORIZED_SUPPRESSIONS set so it doesn't generate an unsafe-suppression diagnostic (D04).

**Same-id deduplication (S03, S05, S21, S22, S24):** Duplicate polls skip notification re-consideration. Equal-issuance timestamps cannot replace displayed severity. Corrected onset cannot displace ordering by authoritative issuance. An expired-then-reactivated row does not carry prior disposition to the new issuance. A replay cannot overwrite an accepted live row.

**Source-provenance at disposition lookup (S11):** `getDisposition` checks `current.source !== alert.source` before returning. `createNotificationGuard` performs the same source check. Covered by mutation.

**NWS shared validator (B01–B13):** `nws-alert-row.mjs` is shared between sidecar (`acceptCollection`) and renderer (`nws-alerts.ts`). CAP id, sent, event, areaDesc, headline, description, severity set, urgency set, status set, messageType set, centroid, geometry are each individually covered by a reversal. Polygon/ring/vertex budget enforcement is covered (B01–B02). The fallback path passes the same `acceptData` validator (B04).

**Stale replay prevention (B15):** No `cacheKey` is passed to `fetchWithFallback` for the NWS route. A failed subsequent fetch returns 503; it does not serve the previous successful payload as fresh. The B15 mutation (which re-adds `cacheKey`) correctly fails the "failed refresh cannot present the previous warning as current" assertion.

**Bundle packaging:** Packaging reversal confirms that removing `sidecar/nws-alert-row.mjs` from `tauri.conf.json` causes the bundle-check script to fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and restoring it passes.

**Combined-branch assumptions:** UX-058-DEFERRED-WARNINGS.md explicitly names the tested combined tree (`f0eb8a9a3c3a7927e87da3b5b5632b6a43705388`) and the four pending drafts (#1844, #1846, #1847, #1848). All user-derived strings (`alert.id`, `alert.source`, `disposition` label) are passed through it before HTML insertion. `SOURCE_LABELS` lookup uses `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call` with an `'Other'` fallback (P10 mutation covers the injection path).
